notes.title: Update 1: Are you ready for a new race car?
notes.content:
Here is the first update released for Rent A Car Simulator 24

A new Race Car class car: Suparama Race Car

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/d73455613398633cd66987fd7e8121a20491a627.png

You can only get the new Suparama Race Car from the car auction and the chances are low. You may have to go to the auction a few days in a row to get it.

* The cars in the new Race Car category drive differently than daily cars and Drift Cars. Their acceleration is quite high.


Is anyone hungry?

Vendors are coming to the world of Rent A Car Simulator 24 for many of your needs. 

Perhaps one of your most important needs (!), the Hot Dog Vendor, is waiting for you right around the corner from your home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/fc7154b1cefd531fc2e7c8d744c7f66fd1440aeb.png

Bug Fixes

* Fixed issue where cars in high-rise offices would appear outside.

* Vehicle repair prices have been adjusted.

* Car spawn frequency has been adjusted. Cars now spawn more frequently.

* If you are stuck anywhere on the map, you can teleport to the office with Shift + Alt + T

This shortcut will be available as a button in the next update.

notes.title: Play Co-Op at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


Hello Car Investors!

Thank you very much for playing the Rent A Car Simulator 24 Prologue version for the past 2 months.

Our Youtuber friends shot many videos. Thanks to everyone for the over 500 individual videos and over 1.5 million unique views we can count.

Now is the Time to Play Co-Op

Rent A Car Simulator 24 was developed in Co-Op from the beginning. And you'll finally be able to try it out in Prologue and Demo versions at Steam Next Fest June 2024.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44952515/a6c1486ad47308429d39a4b5656102d9b4a0e174.png

What does Co-Op Gameplay Content include?

Everything!

Rent Together
Buy Together
Build Together

Manage Your Rent A Car Company Together

Not enough?

Drift Together!

You can play the entire game - all its features - Co-Op with your friends on Steam, establish your Rent A Car company together, build high-rise offices and rent and buy and sell your cars.

This is a brand new way of playing and we are sure you will have a lot of fun.

The Co-Op feature will be available for Prologue and Demo version of the game when Steam Next Fest: June 2024 begins.

Update your games as soon as the festival starts, we are waiting for you to join in the fun!

notes.title: Introducing The Building System
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


Hello Car Investors!

We have new news for you from the development stages of Rent A Car Simulator 24.

Introducing The Building System

In Rent A Car Simulator 24, it is up to you to build your office the way you want.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44952515/6b472aec817dc31dbe9443f3838d2b41216b9424.png

With the detailed construction system, you can build a large single-storey office or a 10-storey plaza.

From an FPS perspective; Build glass frames, walls, stairs and all bilding parts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44952515/12c31279f5ca7103da0b367fa469bdcef6bc61c8.png

You can arrange your cars in the offices you have built and invite your customers to come to your office.

We are developing an elevator to take your cars to the upper floors of your office. You will also have a lot of furniture and items to decorate your office (or maybe your plaza).

* Rent A Car Simulator 24 Construction and Decoration System is fully multiplayer compatible. We seem to see that great offices will be built while playing together.


Newly added Languages

* Added German language translation.
* Added Portuguese language translation.
* Added Russian language translation.
